capabilities: Create topic-specific feeds via a code block in a note
Collect bullet points from notes linking to the topic note
Render the collected bullets as a feed in the topic note
disambiguation: Not an RSS or external feed reader; it aggregates bullet points from your own vault notes.
extras: Not yet available through Community plugins; installation is via BRAT. Support is handled in a forum thread rather than dedicated docs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to aggregate bullet points scattered across notes into a per-topic feed.

relations.evidence: Feeds requires the Dataview plugin to be installed.

summary: Dataview-based plugin that builds a feed of bullet points from notes that link to a given topic note.
